   - The `tcan4x5x_can_remove` function now calls `m_can_class_free_dev(priv->mcan_dev->net)` to free the CAN device when the device is removed.

   - The `m_can_class_register` function has been modified to remove the call to `free_candev(m_can_dev->net)` in the error handling section, as the cleanup is now handled in the probe functions.
   - The `m_can_class_unregister` function also removes the call to `free_candev(m_can_dev->net)`, indicating that the freeing of the CAN device is now managed elsewhere.

This change enhances the modularity and clarity of the code, as the cleanup logic is now centralized in the respective probe and remove functions, making it easier to maintain and understand.

Fix leaking netdev device from peripherial devices. The call to allocate the
